get.summary: Get API health status
get.description: Returns the current health status of the SSO Launcher API.

get.summary: Get applications available to the current user
get.description: Returns active applications the authenticated portal user is currently allowed to launch.

get.summary: Get departments
get.description: Returns the built-in department list used for users, groups, and application categories. Requires an authenticated session.

get.summary: Get sidebar menus for the current user
get.description: Returns active SSO Launcher sidebar menus, ordered by section and sort order.

get.summary: Get dashboard insights for the current user
get.description: Returns the previous successful sign-in of the current user and, for users with the matching menus, the number of locked accounts and failed sign-ins in the last 24 hours.

post.description: Authenticates a portal user and creates the browser session and CSRF cookies.
Revokes the current browser session and removes the session and CSRF cookies.

get.summary: Get the current portal session
get.description: Returns the authenticated portal user and current session state.

post.description: Changes the password of the authenticated user. Requires the current password and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get registered application counts
get.description: Returns the number of registered applications in total, active, under maintenance, and inactive. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get a page of registered applications
get.description: Returns one page of registered applications with search, filters, and sorting applied on the server. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get all registered applications
get.description: Returns all registered SSO Launcher applications. Requires an authenticated administrator.

post.description: Registers a new application in SSO Launcher. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

put.description: Updates an existing registered application. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

delete.description: Deletes an application together with its menus, accesses, and favorites.

get.summary: Get the users who can open an application
get.description: Returns every user with access to one application, including the groups that grant it and whether the access is direct.

get.summary: Get all portal users
get.description: Returns all SSO Launcher users. Requires an authenticated administrator.

post.description: Creates a new SSO Launcher user. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get a page of portal users
get.description: Returns one page of SSO Launcher users with search, filters, and sorting applied on the server. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get portal user counts
get.description: Returns the number of portal users in total, active, and inactive. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get a portal user
get.description: Returns one SSO Launcher user with their groups. Requires an authenticated administrator.

put.description: Updates an existing SSO Launcher user. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

delete.summary: Move a portal user to the recycle bin
delete.description: Soft deletes a user, deactivates the account, and revokes every session. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

post.summary: Reset the password of one user
post.description: Sets a new password for the user and revokes every session. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

post.summary: Revoke every session of one user
post.description: Signs the user out of every device. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get the login lock status of one user
get.description: Returns whether the account is temporarily locked after failed login attempts.

post.summary: Clear the login lock of one user
post.description: Clears the failed login attempts of the account. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get audit records page by page
get.description: Returns audit records newest first, filtered by module, action, outcome, target, actor, IP address, date range, or a search term, one page at a time.

get.summary: Get one audit record in full
get.description: Returns one audit record with device, browser, session, request, reason, and field-level changes.

get.summary: Get audit counters
get.description: Returns the number of records today, in the last seven days, and deletions in the last seven days, using the caller's UTC offset.

get.summary: Get everyone who appears as an actor
get.description: Returns the distinct actors found in the audit log, for the actor filter.

get.summary: Export audit records as an Excel workbook
get.description: Returns up to 10,000 matching records as an .xlsx file, newest first.

get.summary: Get every stored version of one record
get.description: Returns all versions of one record, newest first, with the full snapshot and the fields that changed compared with the previous version. Requires access to the activity history menu.

post.summary: Roll a record back to one of its versions
post.description: Restores the record, including its relations, to the chosen version. The rollback is stored as a new version, so no history is lost. Requires access to the activity history menu, a reason, and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get deleted records of one type
get.description: Returns soft-deleted records with who deleted them, when, and why. Supported types: user, application, user_group, portal_menu, application_menu, access. Requires access to the activity history menu.

post.description: Restores one soft-deleted record and records the restore with before and after snapshots. Requires access to the activity history menu and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get user group counts
get.description: Returns the number of user groups in total, active, inactive, and without members. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get a page of user groups
get.description: Returns one page of user groups with search, filters, and sorting applied on the server. Requires an authenticated administrator.

get.summary: Get all user groups
get.description: Returns every user group with its member and application counts.

post.description: Creates a user group. Requires an administrator and a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get suggested group names for a department
get.description: Returns the job titles of saved users in the given department as suggested group names. Each option carries the id of the group that already uses it, if any. Group names may also be typed freely, as long as they are unique within the department.

get.summary: Get applications that can be granted to a group
get.description: Returns every application that is not inactive, for choosing the applications a group can open.

get.summary: Get a page of users that can be added to a group
get.description: Returns one page of users in the group's department. View "members" limits the list to current members and "others" to users outside the group.

get.summary: Get users that can be added to a group
get.description: Returns the portal users in the group's department, for choosing the members of a group.

get.summary: Get one user group with members and access
get.description: Returns the members of a group and the applications the group can open.

put.description: Updates the name, description, or status of a user group.

delete.description: Deletes a user group together with its members and access mapping.

put.summary: Replace the members of a group
put.description: Replaces the member list of one group with the given user ids.

put.summary: Replace the application access of a group
put.description: Replaces the applications granted through one group.

put.summary: Replace the sidebar menus granted to a group
put.description: Replaces the portal menus that members of one group can see in the sidebar.

post.description: Adds the given users to one group without removing existing members.
Creates a new group with the same description, status, application access, and menu access. Members are not copied.

get.summary: Get all portal menus
get.description: Returns every portal menu. Requires an authenticated super administrator.

post.description: Creates a new sidebar menu. Requires an authenticated super administrator and a valid CSRF token.

put.description: Updates a sidebar menu. System menus keep their target and section.

delete.description: Deletes a sidebar menu. System pages cannot be deleted. Child menus are moved to the menu or section given in moveTo. A section that still has menus requires moveTo, and a menu without moveTo moves its submenus up one level.

put.summary: Reorder portal menus in a section
put.description: Applies menu hierarchy and sort order for one section.

put.summary: Replace the groups that can see a menu
put.description: Replaces the user groups whose members can see one sidebar menu.

get.summary: Get the action catalog of portal menus
get.description: Returns the actions that can be granted per menu, defined in the portal code.

put.summary: Set the maintenance mode of one menu
put.description: Turns maintenance mode on or off for one sidebar menu, with the title and message shown to users.

get.summary: Get favorite application ids
get.description: Returns application ids marked as favorite by the authenticated user.

put.description: Marks an accessible application as favorite for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Removes a favorite entry for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get recent portal activities
get.description: Returns the most recent applications, documents, and features opened by the authenticated user.

post.description: Records an activity entry for the authenticated user and keeps the newest one hundred entries.

delete.description: Deletes every activity entry that belongs to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get recent actions of the current user
get.description: Returns the newest create, update, delete, launch, and favorite actions performed by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a single activity entry that belongs to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get notifications of the current user
get.description: Returns up to 20 notifications from the last 30 days for the signed-in user, with the number of unread notifications.

delete.summary: Delete every notification of the current user
delete.description: Removes every notification of the signed-in user. Requires a valid CSRF token.

post.description: Marks every unread notification of the signed-in user as read.

delete.summary: Delete one notification of the current user
delete.description: Removes one notification of the signed-in user. Requires a valid CSRF token.

get.summary: Get active sessions of the current user
get.description: Returns every active sign-in session of the signed-in user with its device and last activity.

delete.summary: Sign out another session of the current user
delete.description: Revokes one active session of the signed-in user. The current session cannot be revoked here; use logout instead.

post.summary: Sign out every other session of the current user
post.description: Revokes all active sessions of the signed-in user except the current one.

get.summary: Get notification preferences of the current user
get.description: Returns which optional notifications the signed-in user receives. Security notifications are always delivered.

put.summary: Update notification preferences of the current user
put.description: Turns optional notifications for access changes and application status on or off.

get.summary: Get the security rules that apply to accounts
get.description: Returns the session, sign-in lock and password rules currently configured on the server.

get.summary: List portal users who can open the calling application
get.description: Returns active portal users with access to the calling application, with the groups that grant access and whether the access is direct. Requires a service bearer token with the users.read scope. Supports search, updatedSince, page and pageSize (max 200).

get.summary: Check a portal user for the calling application
get.description: Returns whether a portal user is still active and still has access to the calling application. Requires a service bearer token with the users.read scope.

post.summary: Create an SSO launch for an application
post.description: Creates a short-lived SSO token for an application the authenticated user is currently allowed to launch. The request requires a valid CSRF token.
Validates an SSO token for the calling application. Requires a valid service bearer token with the sso.validate scope.

post.summary: Check and extend the portal session of one user
post.description: Tells the calling application whether the user still has an active portal session and access to that application, and refreshes the session so portal and application stay in sync.

post.summary: Record that the user signed out of an application
post.description: Records that the authenticated user signed out of one application and returned to the portal. The portal session stays active. The request requires a valid CSRF token.
Authenticates an application service credential and issues a short-lived bearer token for service-to-service API access.

get.summary: Get service credentials
get.description: Returns service credentials, optionally filtered by application. Requires an authenticated administrator.

post.description: Creates a service credential for an application. The client secret is returned when the credential is created. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.

delete.description: Revokes an existing service credential. Requires an authenticated administrator and a valid CSRF token.
